title: What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.37809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. translated_title: 本体能捕获什么？人工策划、大语言模型生成与数据派生的本体作为知识图谱上LLM智能体的检查器
translated_abstract: 基于Web知识图谱回答问题的LLM智能体，越来越多地被包装在源自图谱本体的检查机制之中，其假设是正式的模式（schema）能成为可靠的裁判。然而检查器本身也可能是错的：它可能遗漏错误，也可能将正确答案标记为错误，并迫使智能体去“修复”这些本来正确的答案。人工策划的本体是否值得作为这样的裁判付出其成本，以及它与LLM撰写的本体或从数据中挖掘出的模式相比表现如何，目前尚不清楚。我们将检查器本身作为研究对象。在人工策划、LLM生成和数据派生的本体中——分别用作提示上下文、用作检查器，或两者兼用——跨越开放权重与专有智能体，在公开图谱和一个拥有近10^9三元组的私有图谱上，我们统计了本体派生的检查到底捕获了什么、又错误标记了什么。我们展示了每种来源如何在捕获错误与误报之间进行权衡，以及人工策划的模式按原样使用时如何与其自身数据相矛盾。
tldr: 该研究首次将本体检查器本身作为研究对象，系统比较了人工策划、LLM生成和数据派生的三类本体在检查知识图谱上LLM智能体时“捕获错误”与“产生误报”之间的权衡关系。
en_tdlr: This study makes the ontology-based checker itself the object of investigation, systematically comparing curated, LLM-generated, and data-derived ontologies in terms of the trade-off between errors caught and false alarms when checking LLM agents over knowledge graphs.
